summary: Artifact + regression verification of the regenerated Sicon Bruno collection (15-point review). Regenerator produced expected artifact counts (372 fields / 348 mapped / 24 sicon-owned / 0 unmapped). All 15 review items pass except R15 wording (see minor issues). Backend pytest suite 40/40 green; /api/sicon/field-mapping endpoint returns HTTP 401 unauth (up).

verification_matrix.R0_regenerate: PASS — generator ran cleanly; reported 372 body fields / 348 mapped / 24 sicon-owned / 0 unmapped; wrote bruno/, FIELD_MAPPING.md, mapping.csv, Sicon-Service-Pulse.bruno.zip (56791 bytes).
verification_matrix.R2_docs_bundled: PASS — zip lists FIELD_MAPPING.md + mapping.csv at zip root AND at bruno/FIELD_MAPPING.md, bruno/mapping.csv.
verification_matrix.R4_docs_field_mapping: PASS — Case Post/Put, Appointment Post/Put, CaseTrackingNote PostOne, Equipment Post/Put all contain a 'Field mapping' table. Note: no CaseTimeBooking route/directory exists in the regenerated collection — original prompt lists 'TimeBooking' but Sicon Service WebAPI has no CaseTimeBooking endpoint in ROUTE_MAP; treated as N/A (see minor note).
verification_matrix.R6_allow_writes_guard: PASS — collection.bru script:pre-request throws unless ALLOW_WRITES=true; Auth path exempt; both environments (Local + Production) default ALLOW_WRITES: false.
verification_matrix.R7_no_auto_select: PASS — no .bru contains setEnvVar('caseTypeId'|'priorityId'|'trackingStatusId'|'statusId', ...); env has selectedCaseTypeId / selectedPriorityId / selectedTrackingStatusId placeholders.
verification_matrix.R8_lookups: PASS — bruno/Lookups/ contains Contracts, CoverTypes, Employees, FaultCodes, SLAs, Skills, Teams (all with GetMany.bru).
verification_matrix.R9_no_default_id_zero: PASS — Cases/Case/PostOne.bru body has '"siSMCaseId": null'; other POST/PUT id-like fields also null.
verification_matrix.R11_get_response_tests: PASS — Case (GetOne_ById + GetOne_ByCaseNumber), Appointment/GetOne, Equipment/GetOne each contain tests('field siSMCaseId present') and _type_* bru.setVar recordings.
verification_matrix.R12_equipment_pagination: PASS — Equipment/GetMany.bru uses '$max={{pageSize}}' (env pageSize=200) and sets bru.setVar('_equipmentPageCount', arr.length) with a pagination test.
verification_matrix.R13_three_layer_legend: PASS — request docs include 'Legend: Bruno var {{appointmentId}} | Sicon field siconAppointmentId | Pulse field appointment.sicon_appointment_id'; FIELD_MAPPING.md echoes the same three-layer distinction.
verification_matrix.R14_direction_words: PASS — FIELD_MAPPING.md contains 374 Direction annotations (Pulse→Sicon / Sicon→Pulse / Bidirectional / Sicon metadata); request docs Direction column present.
verification_matrix.R15_sicon_confirmation_required: PARTIAL — literal label 'SICON CONFIRMATION REQUIRED' present on Equipment/Equipment/PostOne.bru, PutOne.bru, all Lookups (Contracts, CoverTypes, FaultCodes, SLAs, Skills, Teams), Cases/Case/PostOne.bru, Cases/CaseTrackingNote/PostOne.bru, FIELD_MAPPING.md (101 occurrences). NOT literally present on Equipment/GetMany, Equipment/GetOne, or Metadata/Priority/GetMany — those use the equivalent '⚠ UNVERIFIED: … Confirm with Sicon' wording instead. Semantic intent met, literal label inconsistent.
verification_matrix.structural_brace_balance: PASS — 0 unbalanced .bru files; bruno/bruno.json parses as valid JSON.
verification_matrix.backend_regression: PASS — pytest tests/test_sicon_camelcase_inbound.py tests/test_sicon_integration.py tests/test_sicon_deep_mapping.py tests/test_iter_220bi_sicon_field_mapping.py = 40 passed in 0.77s.
verification_matrix.field_mapping_endpoint: UP — GET /api/sicon/field-mapping returns HTTP 401 (auth required) which per spec proves the endpoint is up; no login attempted.

action_items: Optional (R15 label consistency): add the literal 'SICON CONFIRMATION REQUIRED' label to Equipment/GetMany.bru, Equipment/GetOne.bru, and Metadata/Priority/GetMany.bru docs blocks (currently they use '⚠ UNVERIFIED … Confirm with Sicon' which is semantically equivalent). Non-blocking.

Optional (R4 note): the review request lists 'TimeBooking' among request-level mapping docs but the regenerated collection has no CaseTimeBooking route (Sicon Service WebAPI does not expose it). If TimeBooking is intended to ship, add a ROUTE_MAP entry in gen_bruno_sicon_mapping.py; otherwise remove 'TimeBooking' from the review checklist.
critical_code_review_comments: generator script is single-file and long; ROUTE_MAP/CAPTURE_LIST/GET_TEST_FIELDS/METADATA_LIST/LOOKUPS all live in one file — acceptable for a codegen script but consider splitting if it crosses 1000 lines.
env files intentionally leave selected*Id blank so nothing auto-selects — good (R7 intent). Verified no residual setEnvVar for caseTypeId/priorityId/trackingStatusId/statusId across the whole tree.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 review items verified against /app/integrations/sicon/. Only R15 has a labeling inconsistency: literal string 'SICON CONFIRMATION REQUIRED' is missing on Equipment/GetMany, Equipment/GetOne, Metadata/Priority/GetMany (they use '⚠ UNVERIFIED … Confirm with Sicon' instead). All structural checks pass, brace balance clean, bruno.json valid, zip contains docs at both root and bruno/. Backend pytest suite 40/40. Live Sicon host was NOT contacted per instructions.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bug; only a wording-consistency observation on R15.
